name: @vantageos/mcp-doctor
stderr:
usage: mcp-doctor <source-tree-path> [--mode=static|dynamic|both] [--backend=<convex-dir>] [--json]
       mcp-doctor <source-tree-path> --gate [--owed <file>] [--mode=...] [--json]
       mcp-doctor --url <https url> [--bearer-env VAR] [--header "Name: value"]... [--source DIR] [--expected-commit SHA] [--json]
       mcp-doctor --url <https url> [--bearer-env VAR] [--header ...] --events-ready [--events-* ...] [--json]

  --mode=static   read the tree only (default)
  --mode=dynamic  launch the server and judge what it serves
  --mode=both     both, dynamic findings taking precedence
  --local-identity-ceiling=N
                  local identity primitives tolerated before DLocalIdentity
                  fails (default 0)
  --backend=DIR   the backend source (a convex/ dir) whose door list S-28 reads;
                  default: the nearest convex/ above the tree
  --url URL       judge a REMOTE streamable-HTTP server the way a customer reaches it (implies
                  dynamic; no launch target; https, or http on loopback only). Only the rules that
                  judge what a running server serves run; source-tree rules are not run
  --bearer-env VAR   send the token held in environment variable VAR as 'Authorization: Bearer'
                  (the token never appears on a command line or in output)
  --header "Name: value"   an extra request header (repeatable); values are never printed
  --source DIR    with --url: the server's source tree, for D8 eval counts and the C-25 expected
                  commit (git rev-parse HEAD there)
  --expected-commit SHA   with --url: the full commit id the server must serve (C-25)
  --events-ready  with --url: run ONLY the MCP events probe (S-29..S-33): discover, events/list,
                  events/subscribe, callback verification, signed delivery, events/unsubscribe,
                  against an HTTPS receiver it starts (self-signed, generated at run time)
  --events-callback-base URL   a public https URL forwarding to the receiver; without it the
                  checks that need the server to POST are could-not-judge
  --events-receiver-port N     the receiver's local port (the forwarder's target; default any)
  --events-trigger NAME [--events-trigger-args JSON]   the tool whose call causes one event;
                  without it the delivery checks are could-not-judge
  --events-name NAME [--events-args JSON]   the event subscribed to and its arguments
                  (default: the first event listed, {}; two keys or more to probe key order)
  --events-observe-ms N        how long deliveries are watched after the trigger (default 5000)
  --gate          the publish gate (for prepublishOnly): refuse any non-conforming row, any
                  could-not-judge row not declared in the owed file, and any stale declaration
                  (a declared id no longer could-not-judge, or no row of that id). Prints a
                  gate: block (--json: a gate object). Not combinable with --url / --events-ready
  --owed FILE     with --gate: the owed-verdicts file (default <source-tree>/mcp-doctor.owed.json);
                  {"owed": [{"id": "<detector id>", "reason": "<why>"}, ...]}
  --json          print the report as JSON (results, owedHumanVerdicts, exitCode)
  --version       print the version and exit
  --help          print this and exit

exit: 0 clean, 1 a violation, 2 an abstention with no violation (including a target
      that names nothing readable: missing, empty, or not a source tree)
      --gate: 0 passed, 1 refused, 2 the gate could not run (unreadable owed file, unreadable
      tree, a detector failure, a usage error); a violation exits 1 whatever else happened
